flows:
Navigate to https://www.wired.com/ then Work exclusively inside the Reading view dialog.
Use only its listed roles, names and controls.
Remain on this public site.
Stop before sign-in, registration or payment.
If a CAPTCHA or access challenge appears, @v16:"stop and report it".
Never change fixture settings.
Use only visible controls.
Verify the final result on the page.
In Reading view, first assert a top navigation link row such as ‘link · SECURITY’ or the top story headline is present.
Activate SECURITY or the first major story link and verify a section or article page loads.
